text: Men Jokkintini e batteeji ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen Iisaa geɗal Maryama on gomɗinɗo kon ko woni ka Tawreeta, ñaawitori ɗum. Men Okki mo Linjiila yowondirnde e Peewal, goonginnde kon ko adii nde immorde e Tawreeta -si wanaa seeɗa e kon ko "nuskaa" (momtaa) e ñaawooje mayre Men Waɗi Linjiila on wallitornde peewal, e gufo faggitagol ko harmi.
